phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own Queen, opponent unknown but heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when more information about opponent's army composition is available.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansions, maintain ground forces, and keep scouting for opponent's tech.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy and expansions, continue ground development.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Queen Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a specific tech path without scouting; avoid neglecting scouting and defensive positioning.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early midgame, own ground army with Zerglings, opponent unknown but heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent's first combat units appear or when tech advantage is established.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and ground army, increase production and expansions, and scout for opponent's tech.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and ground forces, increase production and expansions.
phase_policies.title: Early Midgame Ground Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to a specific tech path or army composition without more information, neglecting scouting or defensive positioning.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, own Roach/Queen, opponent ground with Stalkers and Void Rays.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if opponent's air presence increases.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army, keep economy stable, and prepare anti-air if needed.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground army, consider adding anti-air if Void Rays become a threat.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Defense with Anti-Air Consideration
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to ground-only forces if opponent's air presence increases; avoid neglecting scouting for tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame, own Zergling/Infestor/Queen/Overseer, opponent ground with Zealots/Stalkers.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if opponent shows air units or heavy tech.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army, continue economy, and consider upgrades while scouting for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground army, continue economy, consider upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Infestor Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to Infestors if the opponent transitions to air; avoid neglecting scouting to detect tech switches.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
